_comment: Soft baselines for non-failing trend warnings in check-debt-budget.ps1. If the live scan exceeds these values, CI prints [WARN] only (exit code still 0 unless hard budget rules fail). Re-baselined 2026-09-05: the previous values dated from May and had been exceeded for months, so every run printed warnings nobody read. These counts track observability and documentation density, not defects - governanceWarningLogCount is warning-level log statements, syncReplayRiskCommentCount is comments marking replay-risk code - and both grew because kiosk, delivery, loyalty and dual-currency landed after the old baseline. Bump intentionally when accepting new growth; do not bump to silence a warning you have not looked at.
